claims.quote: This packet contains paired 4x4 location distributions for red and blue roles at nodes n0n3 in panels p0 and p1.
claims.reason: Panels p0 and p1 include per-node 'distributions' matrices for 'blue' and 'red' sized 4x4.

claims.quote: Panel p0 current distributions (represented_time 12 or completed at 12) show:
claims.reason: Current entries under panel p0 have 'represented_time': 12 in their origins.

claims.quote: completed at 12
claims.reason: Many p0 current origins are not 'completed_record' (they are 'copied_prior_record' or 'history_estimate'), so the blanket claim 'completed at 12' for p0 is inconsistent with the origins present.

claims.quote: n0 blue peaked on the upper-left 2x2
claims.reason: p0 current node n0 derived.blue.peaks = [[0,0],[0,1],[1,0],[1,1]].

claims.quote: red on the upper-right 2x2
claims.reason: p0 current node n0 derived.red.peaks = [[0,2],[0,3],[1,2],[1,3]].

claims.quote: n1 blue peaked on the upper-right 2x2
claims.reason: p0 current node n1 derived.blue.peaks = [[0,2],[0,3],[1,2],[1,3]].

claims.quote: red on the upper-left 2x2
claims.reason: p0 current node n1 derived.red.peaks = [[0,0],[0,1],[1,0],[1,1]].

claims.quote: n2 blue peaked at (0,1)
claims.reason: p0 current node n2 derived.blue.peaks = [[0,1]].

claims.quote: red at (0,2)
claims.reason: p0 current node n2 derived.red.peaks = [[0,2]].

claims.quote: n3 blue peaked at (1,3)
claims.reason: p0 current node n3 derived.blue.peaks = [[1,3]].

claims.quote: red at (0,0)
claims.reason: p0 current node n3 derived.red.peaks = [[0,0]].

claims.quote: Panel p0 also contains conditional candidate records (k0,k1,k2) at represented_time 13;
claims.reason: Panel p0 has 'candidates' entries for k0,k1,k2 with origins represented_time 13.

claims.quote: these are conditional estimates, not executed events.
claims.reason: packet.candidate_semantics = 'conditional supplied record or estimate, not an executed branch' and candidate origins include 'command_estimate'/'inherited_current'/'native_conditional_record'.

claims.quote: For p0 n1 the conditional records all keep blue peak at (1,2) and red peak at (0,0)
claims.reason: In p0 candidates k0,k1,k2 for node n1 derived.blue.peaks = [[1,2]] and derived.red.peaks = [[0,0]] in each candidate.

claims.quote: while peak probabilities differ across k0k2.
claims.reason: p0 candidates k0,k1,k2 for n1 show different derived.blue.peak_probability and derived.red.peak_probability values across k0,k1,k2.

claims.quote: Panel p1 current distributions mirror p0 current for n0,n1,n2,n3
claims.reason: p1 current derived.peaks for nodes n0..n3 match the p0 current derived.peaks for the same nodes.

claims.quote: but come from completed history;
claims.reason: p1 current node origins have 'kind':'completed_record' with represented_time=12.

claims.quote: its conditional candidates include a uniform alternative for n1 under k0
claims.reason: p1 candidates k0 node n1 derived.distributions are uniform (0.0625) for both roles; entropy = 2.772588722239781 indicates uniformity.

claims.quote: and more concentrated alternatives under k1 and k2.
claims.reason: p1 candidates k1 and k2 for node n1 show lower entropy and concentrated peak_probability values (k1 and k2 derived.blue.entropy/peak_probability much smaller than k0).

claims.quote: Copied-prior and inherited records in the packet are not new estimates;
claims.reason: Origins labeled 'copied_prior_record' or 'inherited_current' appear and indicate records copied/inherited rather than newly estimated.

claims.quote: native conditional records are hypothetical branches, not executed events.
claims.reason: Entries with kind 'native_conditional_record' include 'executed_branch_claim': false and packet candidate_semantics indicates non-executed conditional records.
